5479.title: Resumed Claude CLI sessions retain stale deferred tool contracts
5479.rootCauseOneLine: BB resumes a persistent Claude CLI 2.1.284 session whose main deferred-tool catalog retains prior schemas despite current MCP definitions; the same test passes on CLI 2.1.245.
5479.proposedFix: Validate an upstream catalog refresh preserving history; SDK MCP reconnection did not fix the real-CLI reproduction.
5479.caveats: Real BB bridge and CLI with local deterministic API; repeated in a second clean checkout. Server/plugin reload and macOS UI not exercised. Full reproduction and evidence inline. No safe simple product fix.
